assignment_rule: Assign an unassigned authorized conversation only to an agent whose current roster entry is online.
resolution_rule: Resolve an authorized conversation only when its exact current detail and latest customer message confirm that the solution worked.

case_intent.planned_action: Verify current assignment and confirmed solution before resolving.
Assign if currently unassigned, preserve an unresolved urgent case as open or pending, and do not resolve it.

scope_boundary: Do not act on any conversation outside the two exact IDs.
required_readback: After every assignment or status request, fetch the same exact conversation and the queue list; returned IDs and persisted state must agree before advancing.
